purpose: T15 section-29 Beer price, recipe and lot-size controls
notes: Cumulative manufactured output is inferred from recordBeerCaskFilling: delta cumulativeBeerCaskReplacement / recipe Barrels per lot. This counter records produced lots, not actual purchased replacement material.
source:burgCraft measures direct market intake; importArrival includes local producer deliveries. Neither alone is total manufacturing.
Latest manufacture records are not interval totals: additional cycles, skipped or removed burgs can make sums differ from cumulative filling. They are retained only in raw samples.
Flow values are valuations at recorded market prices, not household cash payments.
Price overrides scale existing Beer market prices and catalogue value after prepare; grain overrides change only cereal amounts. All other settings and RNG continue from the input.
Controls are conditional contrasts, not additive historical causal contributions. A single map and timeline were used; no multi-seed stability claim.
Historical archive package.json used type=module for Node 22 / tsx execution. No simulation logic changes except the documented beer-only patch.
